summary.intent: Build and continuously improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) through a long-running autoresearch loop, capturing agentic journeys through the Quadrature Nexus/FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, then using Ouroboros and Mycelium to analyze those journeys and feed improvements back into the system.
summary.outcome: Implemented E1-E77+ experiments validating the Mycelium closed-loop feedback with additive calibration (E57, delta=+0.0625); fixed 300+ test failures; created 10+ new compound engineering modules (CompoundEngine, ExperimentAnalytics, ExperimentScheduler, HealthMonitor, etc.); total test count grew from ~6797 to 7082+; the autoresearch loop runs continuously with HIHO balance tracking and retirement criterion.

repo: The Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically commits working tree changes to orphan branches and resets the working tree to HEAD — edits made via tools can be silently lost unless committed before the next checkpoint cycle
autoresearch.jsonl stores experiment labels in r['asi']['experiment'], uses r['status'] (not 'verdict') for keep/discard, and r['metric'] as the primary signal — not top-level 'delta'
SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables reject arbitrary metadata subfields; variable data must be packed into option<string> fields (e.g. 'result') as JSON rather than using structured subfields

The two-layer calibration model: _mycelium_calibration (cross-cycle accumulator, += semantics) vs _score_adjustments (per-deliberation, SET by run_llm_deliberation on every call) — Mycelium feedback must target _mycelium_calibration, not _score_adjustments
Lemonade LLM enters silent failure state where all structured evaluation prompts return empty strings but arithmetic works; probe with '2+2=' not /models endpoint
The ruff-format pre-commit hook reformats files after staging, causing the staged version to differ from HEAD and blocking commits — must run 'uv run ruff format <file>' before staging
vault_find_relevant_context is async; synchronous callers must use vault_search (the sync wrapper) to avoid RuntimeWarning about unawaited coroutines
psutil mock in compound tests needs both virtual_memory AND cpu_percent mocked — the resource guardrail checks CPU usage (~80% threshold) on every execute_task() call
The UCB1 exploration policy in beam_search was incorrectly used for best-answer selection — perfect-score candidates were excluded from the beam because untested transforms have UCB1=∞

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback had SET semantics (_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment) causing cycle 2 to overwrite cycle 1's calibration with a smaller value. Fixed to _mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment (additive accumulation). Also added _detect_oscillation(): when last 3 adjustments alternate sign, lr is halved.

Error classification now tracks error_type, error_category (transient/resource/logic/permanent), and retryable flag. But this code is frequently reverted by the checkpoint daemon — moved to error_classifier.py instead.

UCB1 exploration policy was incorrectly selecting the 'best' chain — actual_best must be tracked BEFORE UCB1 narrows the beam; candidates with 0 trials always rank higher via UCB1=∞, blocking high-scoring transforms from being selected.

Must patch httpx.AsyncClient (not httpx.Client) in tests; use AsyncMock for post and aclose; wrap all client.connect()/vault_*()/_call_tool() calls with asyncio.run() in unittest.TestCase test methods. Added vault_write_sync/vault_read_sync/vault_delete_sync that explicitly close coroutines to prevent RuntimeWarning.
_find_project_root() must fall back to the repo root (pyproject.toml or CLAUDE.md) when no .context directory is found, rather than raising ContextLoadError.
Called vault_find_relevant_context() (async) without await in synchronous context. Fixed to use vault_search() (sync wrapper).

Improvement classification must respect direction ('minimize' vs 'maximize') — a lower metric is an improvement for minimize metrics. Also _update_tree() must accept both string hypothesis and ExperimentOutcome objects for backward compatibility.
autouse fixture must mock BOTH psutil.virtual_memory AND psutil.cpu_percent — the resource guardrail checks CPU in addition to memory, causing test failures on busy machines.
vault_write/vault_read/vault_delete were called synchronously without await. Fixed by using vault_write_sync/vault_read_sync/vault_delete_sync wrappers from MCPClient.

log_result stores data in r['asi']['experiment'] format; retirement logic must read r.get('asi',{}).get('experiment') not r.get('experiment'). The spin-loop guard (remaining_s < 30: break) and max(30.0, timeout) floor are critical to prevent negative asyncio.wait_for timeouts.

workflow: New Python files (not modifications to existing ones) persist through the checkpoint cycle more reliably — prefer creating new modules over editing large existing files when working in long sessions
TDD for autoresearch experiments: write hypothesis → falsification criterion → structural invariants (V-model) BEFORE running the experiment to prevent re-running converged experiments 4000+ times
Retirement criterion (CV < 0.05 after 20 keeps) prevents converged experiments from consuming compute — add it from the start, not as an afterthought
The 'compile with python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open(...).read())"' check is faster than running the full test suite for syntax validation
When asyncio.run() raises RuntimeError ('loop already running'), must explicitly call .close() on the coroutine before creating a new event loop, otherwise RuntimeWarning is emitted
The convergence formula for Mycelium compounding: consensus_n = 0.85 - 0.125*(1-lr/2)^n — asymptotically approaches threshold, never crosses it unless lr >= 2.0

friction: The Entire.io checkpoint daemon repeatedly reverts working tree changes to HEAD, destroying hours of work (E55-E62 Gemini worktree was lost entirely, requiring full reimplementation)
The ruff-format pre-commit hook reformats files after staging, breaking the commit cycle — requires a run/format/stage/commit loop instead of simple stage/commit
autoresearch.jsonl being git-tracked caused pre-commit stash conflicts that blocked commits; had to remove from git tracking with git rm --cached
Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack enters silent failure state after extended use — all structured evaluation prompts return empty strings with no error indication
SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables silently reject arbitrary metadata subfields (no error raised, data just not stored), requiring significant debugging to discover
The Gemini worktree containing E55-E62 (3500+ line overnight loop) was silently cleaned up, losing all new experiment code and requiring reimplementation from scratch
Multiple overnight loop processes accumulated silently across restarts — had to kill them all with pkill
Pre-commit's playwright hook runs unconditionally (no files: filter) on every commit regardless of what changed, requiring server at localhost:3000
asyncio.wait_for() with negative timeout silently causes an infinite spin-loop rather than raising an error immediately
open_items: 8 remaining compound test ordering failures (pre-existing state leakage between test files — tests pass in isolation but fail in full suite)
Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack needs manual recovery before LLM mode experiments can resume; current loop runs in heuristic mode only
The experiment_runs table in SurrealDB has 0 records — new E55-E62 experiments use nexus.deliberate() directly (bypass telemetry bus), so they don't write journey_point records
PR #113 (autoresearch/pr-merge-20260502) is open with all session improvements but needs CI review and merge
The retirement feedback loop in overnight_evo_loop.py reads r.get('delta', 0) but should use r.get('metric', 0) for the JSONL format — fixed but may have been reverted
The oscillation detection in QuadratureNexus reduces lr by 0.5 when detected, but there are no tests verifying the actual lr reduction (only that oscillation is detected)

CompoundEngine and the analytics subsystem modules (experiment_analytics, experiment_scheduler, etc.) need to be wired into the actual production CompoundExecutor flow — currently they are standalone utilities
SurrealDB journey_point records from E55-E62 experiments are missing (225K records exist from earlier experiments but none from the new methodology-focused experiments)
vault.py async calls (vault_write, vault_read, vault_delete) that were fixed to use sync wrappers may have been reverted by checkpoint daemon
